# Add to Reading List

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Adds a URL to your reading list.

## Syntax

~~~~text
addToReadingList(urls: <#Array#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
addToReadingList(urls: https://jellycuts.com)
~~~~
